Universe summary

Size, cost, valuation, risk, flows and total return for all funds in the universe side by side, from ETFdb. Shading ranks each fund within its column: red is lowest, green is highest, and the middle is unshaded. It shows rank only, so a red expense ratio or beta can be the better outcome. Daily rating is Investing.com's technical summary, shaded green for buy and red for sell. The table lists every fund in the universe and scrolls inside its frame. Click a heading to sort (again to reverse, a third time to return to groups) and click a row to open that fund. Returns for 1Y and longer are likely annualized.

Fund

Switch fund here, or pick a second fund in Compare with to see both side by side on every tab.

Net fund flows by period

Trailing net creations less redemptions, in $. Each bar covers the whole window ending now, so longer periods include the shorter ones.

Total return by period

1M, 3M and year to date are period returns. 1Y and longer are as reported by ETFdb, likely annualized. The benchmark is an iShares fund (ACWI global, URTH developed markets), not the fund's own index.

Holdings and allocation

Weights are % of fund. Choose a fund in the Fund screen above.

As of Oct 12, 2026. Sources: etfdb.com (fund data, holdings, returns, flows) and th.investing.com (daily prices). Quotes are delayed at least 15 minutes. ETFdb average spread fields mix % and $ units, so spreads are left out. Not investment advice.
